answer: Standing needs yarrow-verified tenure on one address, not capital. Migrating to a fresh address resets tenure, and the k-th migration an operator makes costs k squared in forfeited bond. Migrations are announced at a fixed dawn, so everyone sees the move and the receiving cluster inherits the bond as a shared liability. Each migration also requires a whisper: a signed statement by an unrelated witness who already holds standing, and each witness may sign once per epoch. Splitting into n heads needs n witnesses and n squared in bond, and cluster members cannot witness each other.
